d: In April 2010, Delhi’s Mayapuri scrap market became the centre of a terrifying radiation scare. Scrap dealer Deepak Jain and several workers suffered severe radiation injuries after coming into contact with radioactive Cobalt-60 from an old gamma cell auctioned by Delhi University. One worker died, exposing serious lapses in radioactive waste disposal and nuclear safety regulations. This Tarikh episode investigates the Mayapuri radiation accident, the role of AERB, BARC, NAPS and NDMA, and how radioactive sources entered the scrap market. Discover the shocking story of Cobalt-60 radiation,…
